title: One Fungus Has Already Erased 90 Amphibian Species
hook: The deadliest wildlife disease recorded is still pushing frogs toward extinction.
closing: A disease that already erased species is still shrinking amphibian life today.
question: Should fungus monitoring expand?

segments.say: Chytrid fungus drove 90 amphibian species extinct. No other recorded disease has erased wildlife on this scale.
Thirty-nine percent of affected species are still declining. The extinction wave has not ended.
The fungus has hit 40 Australian frog species. Its damage keeps spreading across vulnerable amphibians.
